section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the data analysis procedures used in the study. IBM SPSS (v.22) was used for descriptive and correlational analyses, while AMOS (v.22) was used for path analysis. Pearson correlation analyses were performed to examine associations between social safeness (SSPS), self-reassurance (FSCRS_reassure), body appreciation (BAS-2), and eating psychopathology (EDE-Q). Path analyses tested whether the association between social safeness and disordered eating would be mediated by self-reassurance and body appreciation while controlling for BMI, using Maximum Likelihood estimation and Bootstrap resampling with 5000 samples.
